## Description

web/portal PWA with BFF session: invitation from registration (portal consent) → OTP to the registered mobile → session; rate limiting; device remember option; patient can be linked to several clinics (separate tenants) with a clinic switcher.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Patients sign in with OTP; brute force is rate-limited and locked per policy.
- [ ] **AC2.** A patient sees only their own records (and proxies they hold); IDOR tests pass on all portal endpoints.
- [ ] **AC3.** Portal p95 < 2 s on mobile for home and records (measured on 4G profile).
- [ ] **AC4.** Sessions expire and can be revoked; no tokens in browser storage.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../docs/05-delivery/README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
